span.label: gene-signature methods score cell-type-specific gene sets INDEPENDENTLY per cell type; deconvolution methods model the tissue's expression as a WEIGHTED SUM of the component cells' profiles. Two different mathematical objects behind one output name

span.label: THE QUANTITY IS NOT MEASURED. `DUE TO THE LIMITATIONS OF DIRECT MEASUREMENT METHODS, computational algorithms are often used to INFER immune cell composition` - and the transcriptome `does not immediately indicate` it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: SIX ALGORITHMS, ONE OUTPUT NAME, AND ONLY TWO PRODUCE A QUANTITY ON A MEANINGFUL SCALE: `EPIC AND quanTIseq HAVE THE ADVANTAGE OF DIRECTLY GENERATING SCORES INTERPRETED AS CELL FRACTIONS`. The other four produce enrichment scores displayed beside them
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: each algorithm is named with its own failure: TIMER handles tissue specificity but covers only six cell types, xCell covers more but MAY FAIL TO DETECT SIGNALS FROM HOMOGENEOUS SAMPLES
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the justification for running all six is a HOPE, in the authors' own word: `WE HOPE THAT evaluating estimations from multiple algorithms MIGHT HELP the user gain more comprehensive and robust results`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the cross-species use is caveated where it is offered: mouse estimations `SHOULD BE INTERPRETED WITH CAUTION since human and the mouse tumors may have different immune properties`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: all TCGA samples are pre-processed UNIFORMLY before the six algorithms run, so the estimates differ by algorithm and not by pipeline
span.note: eliminates: disagreement between algorithms that is really disagreement between normalisations - which is the only way the side-by-side display could mean anything · outcome: held

span.note: eliminates: nothing that is demonstrated here - the claim is `we HOPE ... MIGHT HELP`, with no comparison against single-algorithm use reported · outcome: absent-declared-unreported
